title: R4 typed bounded CLI, noninteractive, and ACP executable contract

law_conformance.note: R4 reconstructs the ratified Rust client boundary; the frozen TypeScript engine is not advanced.

preserves: typed versioned grapt-api DTO client only
text JSON and JSONL output contracts
bounded stdin stdout stderr SSE and ACP dimensions
durable relist convergence after advisory live events
server-authoritative SIGINT SIGTERM and ACP cancellation
intentionally_excludes: direct Core runtime or database access

determinism.clock: No wall-clock identity or deadline is read; finite transport and launch scheduling use monotonic Tokio allowances.
determinism.identifiers: All project and session identities cross the client boundary as grapt-types values and grapt-api WireId wrappers.
determinism.network: Production remote mode is HTTPS-only; test loopback is feature-gated and production discovery requires attributed identity.
determinism.filesystem: Credential and registration reads are bounded, regular-file-only, and discovery re-reads exact registration bytes after attribution.

record_contracts.actions: One executable public-seam operation per R4 CLI/ACP case.
record_contracts.durable: One closed expected authoritative outcome for every action case.
record_contracts.state: The exact sorted case set and count derived from actions and durable rows.

evidence.claim: Every corpus operation is dispatched through the binary, executor, Runner, ApiClient, loopback server, child-owner, and bounded-output public seams.
Request counts prove validate/effect/commit ordering and no state advance after remote failure.
The real Runner refuses convergence defects and emits only authoritative durable data.
